2012 NISSAN NV LINEUP
INNOVATION THAT WORKS. More than a van, it’s a new way of doing business. We started
by asking you what current vans do right, and what they don’t. We listened. We learned. And then we
really went to work. The result is the groundbreaking NV Lineup, with a choice of Standard and High
Roof models and three different grades to match your needs. With powerful and reliable drivetrains
and fully boxed full-length ladder frames, it’s up for any job. With up to 323 cubic feet of cargo space
and loaded with innovation from the biggest idea to the smallest detail, getting the job done has never
been easier. It’s time to rethink the way you do business, and time to put the Nissan NV Lineup to
work for you.
